description: Physical and digital storage media containing sensitive information is not protected from unauthorized access. This signal indicates that media may be accessed, copied, or removed without appropriate controls.
applicability: Applicable to all storage media including removable devices, backup media, printed materials, and portable storage. Includes physical access controls, encryption, and media handling procedures.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of media handling procedures, physical access controls for media storage, and encryption requirements for removable media.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
